author: Moanwar
body:
This PR updates the truth graph information by introducing a new flag to identify reconstructable particles from the Particle-Flow perspective.

The motivation comes from discussions within the PF group regarding which particle states along a decay chain should be considered reconstructable and therefore treated as targets for PF reconstruction.

The underlying principle is that PF should reconstruct particles that interact with the detector material, rather than necessarily targeting the final-state particles in the decay chain. Based on this principle, the following criteria are used to identify reconstructable particle states:

Tracks: Charged particles with at least 2 tracker SimHits.

Calorimeter objects: Particles with at least 1 calorimeter SimHit.

Muons: Particles with at least 2 tracker SimHits and at least 1 muon hit.

pi mesons: The reconstruction targets are their decay photons rather than the pi0 itself.

Converted photons: The photon remains the reconstruction target at the calorimeter level, while its conversion may produce two tracks (electron and positron will be considered as target) in the tracker.

This new flag provides an explicit indication of which particle states should be considered reconstruction targets for PF studies and can be used consistently when building and interpreting the truth graph slides : https://indico.cern.ch/event/1750172/#1-followup-discussion-from-the
